verdict.stance: Neutral / High-Margin Ring-Fenced Israeli Gas Notes vs Geopolitical Risk
verdict.summary: Energean Israel Finance notes are senior secured by the Karish/Tanin offshore gas FPSO delivering long-term domestic Israeli GSAs (~$1.12bn group FY25 EBITDAX, 2.9x net leverage). Near-term spreads reflect temporary 2026 security-mandated Israeli production suspensions and upcoming Mar-28 bullet refinancing.

positives: Senior secured ring-fenced pledge over Karish/Tanin offshore reserves, FPSO, and domestic GSAs.
High-margin gas sales (~63% group EBITDAX margin) with long-term CPI/electricity-linked floor contracts.
6-year weighted average group debt maturity profile with minimal near-term amortization.
negatives: Temporary government-mandated operational suspensions in Israel in early 2026 amid regional security escalations.
Single-FPSO offshore operational concentration (Energean Power FPSO).
FY25 net loss of $258m from non-cash Cassiopea impairment and elevated group net debt ($3.26bn).
